headline: Domain and archive-scale databases expand coverage, unify annotation and modernize infrastructure
label: Biological Database Infrastructure
summary: New database releases expand structural, viral, ERV and pathogen resources while INSDC reports archive growth beyond 75 PB and new governance.
synthesis: The dominant thread is maintenance and expansion of curated public resources. RR3DD 2.0 classifies 15,764 RNA chains into 1,042 RMscore clusters mapped to Rfam; BFVD v3 supplies ColabFold-AlphaFold2-predicted viral protein structures; ERV Navigator unifies human endogenous retrovirus annotations, nomenclatures and loci in a phylogenetically informed reference. VEuPathDB 2026 reports 2,602 datasets for eukaryotic pathogens, vectors and hosts, alongside OrthoMCL, AI-assisted curation and a PostgreSQL migration. INSDC reports an archive above 75 PB, new governance, a membership pathway and planned AI-assisted metadata work. New elements are consolidated classification and nomenclature in domain resources, plus infrastructure and metadata changes at larger scale. vartracker is a tool for longitudinal pathogen variant analysis rather than a database, so it sits at the edge of this thread.
